description: This file defines models and a fetcher for retrieving and processing real GDP data from EconDB, including query parameter validation, data transformation, and asynchronous data extraction.

classes.name: EconDbGdpRealQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for EconDB GDP Real data, including country validation.

classes.name: EconDbGdpRealData
classes.description: Represents the GDP real data with growth rates and value.

classes.name: EconDbGdpRealFetcher
classes.description: Handles fetching, transforming, and processing GDP real data asynchronously.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Converts generic parameters into specific query parameter object.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches and processes GDP data for specified countries.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw data into structured GDP real data objects, filtering by date range.
